reviewed.note: Built from the Acond Integration entity catalog, sensor and binary-sensor platforms, entity ID generation, and manifest; entity IDs cross-checked against one Home Assistant installation. The manual's P02 alarm entry identifies the plate-exchanger outlet temperature as flow, and its RCM2-1 symbols identify the outdoor fan and two circulation pumps. A Home Assistant observation during DHW and space heating maps circulation_pump to the heat-pump primary pump and circulation_pump_output to the system pump. P01 system return has no distinct entity in the supplied entity list.

unmapped.return: The manual identifies a system-return probe as P01, but the supplied HA entity list has no distinct entity for it.
